sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42737 of 2023
Applicant :- Ishtiyaq Ahmad And 5 Others

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravindra Prakash Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the State.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicants for quashing the entire
proceeding along with cognizance/summoning order dated 28.3.2022 passed by Judicial
Magistrate/F.T.C. (Crime Against Women), Basti on the charge sheet dated 21.1.2022 in Case
No.702 of 2022 (State Vs. Imtiyaz Ahmad and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 Ipc and
Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Basti arising out of Case Crime No.55 of 2021
pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate/F.T.C. (Crime Against Women), Basti.

entities.text: State Vs. Imtiyaz Ahmad and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3.  After some argument, learned counsel for the applicants prays that applicants may be permitted to move appropriate application before the Court concerned as provided under Section 227 of the Cr.P.C.
4.
This prayer has not been opposed by the learned AGA.
5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants are permitted to appear before the concerned court within 15 days from today and move an application claiming discharge.
